title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0000e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.001000
  m_eff = 2.3452e-1 eV
  T_vev = 2.2361e+0 m⁻²
  ω = 0.2233 s⁻¹
  k = 0.0100 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.044776 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -9.654e+0
  J_spin = -5.824e-1
